rows: Consent can be formally present but ethically hollow under deception or coercion.
Declaration of Helsinki: IRB review, vulnerability, placebo limits
Professional standards can exceed local legal minimums.
Belmont: respect for persons, beneficence, justice
Principles require interpretation; they do not mechanically resolve tradeoffs.
Common Rule IRB review and informed consent
IRB approval is a regulatory floor, not proof the study is ethically ideal.
HIPAA identifiers, covered entities, and de-identification
HIPAA scope is narrower than "all health-related data."
GDPR consent, purpose limitation, minimization, lawful basis
Research exemptions exist, but purpose and data minimization still matter.
Exempt, expedited, or full board based on risk/category
"Exempt" still requires IRB determination; researchers do not self-exempt.
